release_notes: v0.4.6: Processing stability, security, and 50-call readiness. Single-instance guard, hidden ffmpeg/ffprobe windows, conservative API concurrency with automatic service_busy retry/backoff and Retry-After support, improved batch retry handling, PII-safe filename logging, deterministic AI-summary PII redaction on API, local NOT_CONNECTED/NC consistency, admin support-status endpoint, PyJWT migration, and updated upload parser dependency. Stabilizes the current architecture; the premium 300+ call engine remains planned for v0.5.0.
